intro: Lesson 35: Fragile environments and climate change (Paper 2, Topic 7, global issue). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Section C style practice (portal printable): (a) Describe the distribution of areas at risk of desertification. (3) (b) Explain two causes of deforestation in a named tropical rainforest. (4) (c) Assess the effectiveness of global responses to climate change. (8)
questions.a: (a) edges of hot deserts, e.g. Sahel south of the Sahara, parts of central Asia (b) cattle ranching, soy, logging with detail (c) Paris Agreement strengths and limits, finance, judgement

questions.q: Explain how one local community has adapted to a fragile environment.
questions.a: e.g. stone lines in Burkina Faso trap water and soil, raising yields

questions.q: Explain one way deforestation contributes to climate change.
questions.a: Trees store carbon (1); burning or clearing releases carbon dioxide and fewer trees absorb it (1)
questions.model: Trees store carbon. Cut or burned: carbon released. Less absorbed afterwards.
